gen-gf-libertinus-mono-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega reads friendly and modern, its letters drawn with one nib and its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. And Libertinus Mono is the foil, a precise monospace heading whose strokes swell gently from hairline to stem.
gen-gf-libertinus-mono-gf-lexend-peta: Tall, tidy, a bit bookish. If the Libertinus Mono heading shrinks, its fine modulation gets lost, while Lexend Peta keeps its wide-mouthed curves and big x-height, and none of its strokes ever thin.
gen-gf-libertinus-mono-gf-lexend-tera: Precise is the first word for Libertinus Mono, a monospace heading with tall little letters and lightly shifting stroke weight. Lexend Tera does the opposite job well, laying out ruler-straight, widely spaced sans letters with open curves.
gen-gf-libertinus-mono-gf-lexend-zetta: Libertinus Mono has an s with ends hanging far from its spine. Lexend Zetta, a widely tracked sans-serif of ribbon-like strokes, gives that slight stroke modulation a smooth, contemporary counterweight to push against.
gen-gf-libertinus-mono-gf-montserrat-alt: Montserrat Alternates reads contemporary, with round letters whose rims match the stems and lowercase crowding the capital line. Libertinus Mono sits above it, modulated and precise.
gen-gf-lisu-bosa-gf-cascadia-mono: Authoritative is Lisu Bosa's tone, a serif heading with a deep middle band and strokes that taper only slightly. Cascadia Mono then carries the text in wire-like sans strokes, letters standing like pins in a wide board, so a long passage moves steadily.
gen-gf-lisu-bosa-gf-julius-sans-one: Julius Sans One is a plain sans of bold, uniform strokes with generous gaps between letters. Lisu Bosa feels warmer beside it, its serif strokes swelling moderately, which makes the two feel like a talker and a quiet counterpart.
gen-gf-lisu-bosa-gf-lexend-exa: Literary meets measured. Lexend Exa brings a monoweight skeleton, wide curves and a big x-height, and that firm sans-serif footing makes Lisu Bosa's hairline-thinned curves stand out.
gen-gf-lisu-bosa-gf-lexend-mega: Lisu Bosa leads with a literary, authoritative serif voice. Lexend Mega follows in strokes of one width, and bumping the heading up a size would let its medium contrast show against that plainness.
gen-gf-lisu-bosa-gf-lexend-peta: Literary, with a wide-open welcome. Lisu Bosa does best at mellow, thick-to-thin authority, while Lexend Peta does best at fixed-nib sans-serif strokes with a big x-height and wide-mouthed curves.
